Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't trigger. Effects that play into the breeding area aren't considered hatching, so it doesn't trigger this effect.
Card Q&A.q: Is this card's [All Turns] effect triggered by "play into an empty space in your breeding area without paying the cost" effects?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. When this card is newly played, the [End of Your Turn] timing has already passed, and the effect can't activate.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to play a copy of this card, can I activate the [End of Your Turn] effect on the newly played copy of this card?
